gloss: range of increase; margin of rise; amount of gain

definitions.gloss: range of increase; margin of rise; amount of gain
definitions.explanation: The magnitude by which something rises, particularly a price, stock value, temperature, or numerical figure. Often contrasted with {下|さ}げ{幅|はば} (range of decrease).

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|あ}げ{幅|はば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The rise in the stock price is large.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賃金|ちんぎん}→賃金：04842_chingin⟧{上|あ}げ{幅|はば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{過去最大|かこさいだい}になった。
examples.english: This year's pay raise was the largest on record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中央銀行|ちゅうおうぎんこう}→中央銀行：10173_chuuouginkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|あ}げ{幅|はば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{0.25|ぜろてんにいご}⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えた→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦{減速|げんそく}→減速：13336_gensoku_deceleration⟧⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Behind the central bank's decision to limit the rate hike to 0.25% lie concerns about an economic slowdown.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise) + ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ (width, range). Frequent in financial news, economic reports, and discussions of price changes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|あ}げ{幅|はば}: stock price increase
- {上|あ}げ{幅|はば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧/⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧: large/small rise
- {上|あ}げ{幅|はば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to limit/curb the rise
- {上|あ}げ{幅|はば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to widen the rise
- {過去最大|かこさいだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|あ}げ{幅|はば}: the largest rise on record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下|さ}げ{幅|はば}: range of decrease — the direct antonym
- ⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧: range of price increase — more specifically about price
- {騰落|とうらく}: rise and fall — broader market term covering both directions
